permissions.purpose: Read the customer's tax IDs, email and billing country so they can be verified against EU VIES and national checksum rules.
Optionally save the verification status and certificate link to the customer's metadata when you click "Save to customer".

content_security_policy.purpose: Sends the customer's tax ID and email domain to the Tax ID Verify API, which checks EU VIES, check digits and DNS records and returns a signed audit certificate.
